options.name: comment
options.description: Commit comment to be associated with the configuration changes. This allows tracking the reason for configuration changes (e.g., change management ticket).

options.name: config
options.description: A list of OSPFv3 process configuration.

options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the Junos device by executing the command B(show protocols ospf). The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in.
